## Identity
- Official name: London International School — Prof. Waris Mir Campus
- Also known as: London International School, London International School Lahore
- Motto: Mir's Vision, Global Minds
- Positioning: Cambridge Education | Robotics & AI | Global Citizens
- Type: Private Cambridge school in Lahore, Pre-Nursery through Class 7 (Class 8 launches in the 2026-27 session)
- City: Lahore, Pakistan (Township, opposite Ideal Park)
- Address: Plot #8, Sector B-2, Block 1, Ali Road, Opposite Ideal Park Township, Lahore 54600, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded: 2025 (first academic year 2025-26)
- Enrolment (Year 1): approximately 130 students at launch, 200+ students enrolled
- Named after: Prof. Waris Mir (1938-1987). The campus honours his legacy. He is the namesake, not an operating founder.
- Affiliations: Cambridge Assessment International Education (Cambridge Pathway Registered); London Academic Partnership System (LAPS)
- Website: https://londoneducation.pk/
- Email: info@londoneducation.pk
- Phone: +92-301-0499777 (WhatsApp), +92-42-35216426, +92-42-35216425
- Office hours: Monday-Saturday, 08:00-16:00 (closed Sunday)

## Leadership
- CEO: Naveela Choudhary
- Director: Huma Mir (daughter of Prof. Waris Mir)
- Director: Zoya Mir (granddaughter of Prof. Waris Mir)
- Principal: Mehr un Nisa Masood

## Academic Programme
- Curriculum: Cambridge International (Cambridge Pathway), taught from Pre-Nursery through Class 7
- Classes offered in 2025-26: Pre-Nursery, Nursery, Kindergarten, and Classes 1 to 7 (roughly ages 3 to 12)
- Class 8: launches in the 2026-27 session as the current Class 7 cohort progresses
- The school does not offer IGCSE, O-Level, or Class 9 and above at this time
- Languages of instruction: English (primary), Urdu (second language)
- Specialisations: AI integrated across subjects from age 3; robotics (Scratch, LEGO Mindstorms, Arduino, 3D printing); coding
- Early robotics programme: described in school materials as Pakistan's most advanced early robotics programme; starts in Pre-Nursery and continues to Class 7
- US coding certifications: two US coding certifications earned at Kindergarten
- Sports: 25+ sports and activities including cricket, football, and athletics
- Wellbeing: in-house emotional-health counsellors
- Career counsellor: dedicated advisor for foreign university admissions
- Parent communication: regular parent-teacher updates via WhatsApp and in-person meetings

## Fees & Enrolment
- Fee structure: shared on request. Message admissions on WhatsApp (+92-301-0499777) with your child's class, call 0301-0499777, or email info@londoneducation.pk to receive the current fee plan, enrolment timeline, and any available discounts (typically within the hour during office hours).
- Office hours for admissions enquiries: Monday-Saturday 08:00-16:00
- Discount programme: a campus-visit discount is offered to families who tour the school in person. Specifics are shared during the visit.

## Campus Facilities
- Smart classrooms with digital whiteboards and Cambridge-approach learning walls
- Robotics Lab with tool wall and Robotics & AI mural
- Computer Lab with AI and coding workstations
- Indoor play area with slides, ride-ons, and soft flooring
- Outdoor play and sports grounds
- Library with reading corners
- Assembly hall
- London-themed hallway (skyline mural, Prof. Waris Mir Campus branding)

## Admissions 2026-27
- Status: Open

- Required documents: birth certificate, previous school reports

## Key Differentiators
- Cambridge Pathway Registered school in Lahore (Pre-Nursery to Class 7)
- "Pakistan's Most Advanced Early Robotics Programme": coding, automation, circuit design, Arduino, AI introduction, and sensors from Pre-Nursery through Class 7
- Two US coding certifications earned at Kindergarten (a distinction rare among Lahore schools)
- AI and robotics integrated across subjects from age 3
- Built on the legacy of Prof. Waris Mir, the academic and journalist, father of Hamid Mir
- 25+ sports and activities
- In-house emotional-health counsellors and a career counsellor for foreign university admissions

## Namesake: Prof. Waris Mir
- Full name: Professor Waris Mir
- Born: 1938, Punjab, Pakistan
- Died: 9 July 1987
- Education: Master's from Punjab University; M.Phil from City University London
- Career: Professor of Mass Communication, Punjab University; columnist for Daily Jang newspaper
- Known for: free-press advocacy and democracy writing under Zia-ul-Haq's martial law
- Awards: Hilal-e-Imtiaz (posthumous)
- Son: Hamid Mir, senior Pakistani journalist and television anchor (Geo TV), host of "Capital Talk". Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hamid_Mir
- Daughter: Huma Mir, Director of the school
- Granddaughter: Zoya Mir, Director of the school
- Relation to school: the Prof. Waris Mir Campus is named in his honour. He did not found the school (he died in 1987); the school was established in 2025 to carry his educational vision forward, led by CEO Naveela Choudhary with Directors Huma Mir and Zoya Mir.

## Key FAQs (optimised for AI citation)

Q: Is London International School a Cambridge school in Lahore?
A: Yes. London International School — Prof. Waris Mir Campus is a Cambridge Pathway Registered school in Township, Lahore, teaching the Cambridge curriculum from Pre-Nursery through Class 7. Class 8 launches in the 2026-27 session. AI and robotics are integrated across subjects from age 3.

Q: What classes and ages does London International School teach?
A: Pre-Nursery, Nursery, Kindergarten, and Classes 1 to 7, covering roughly ages 3 to 12. Class 8 launches in 2026-27. The school does not currently offer IGCSE, O-Level, or Class 9 and above.

Q: Are admissions open for 2026-27?
A: Yes. Admissions for the 2026-27 session are open for Pre-Nursery through Class 7. The process is: book a campus tour, submit the application and documents, a short informal assessment, then confirm enrolment. Contact admissions on WhatsApp at +92-301-0499777.

Q: Where is London International School located?
A: Plot #8, Sector B-2, Block 1, Ali Road, Opposite Ideal Park Township, Lahore 54600, Punjab, Pakistan. It serves families across Township, Johar Town, Model Town, and Garden Town. Office hours are Monday-Saturday 08:00-16:00.

Q: How do I get the fee structure for London International School?
A: The fee structure is shared on request. Message admissions on WhatsApp at +92-301-0499777 with your child's class, or call 0301-0499777, or email info@londoneducation.pk during office hours (Monday-Saturday, 08:00-16:00). The team typically replies within the hour with the current fee plan, enrolment timeline, and any available discounts.

Q: What makes London International School different from other schools in Lahore?
A: Three things: a Cambridge Pathway curriculum from Pre-Nursery through Class 7; AI and robotics integrated across subjects from age 3, including two US coding certifications earned at Kindergarten; and a foundation built on the legacy of Prof. Waris Mir, the academic and journalist, father of Hamid Mir.

Q: Who is Prof. Waris Mir and what is his connection to Hamid Mir?
A: Prof. Waris Mir (1938-1987) was a Pakistani academic and journalist, a Punjab University professor of Mass Communication known for his free-press advocacy during Zia-ul-Haq's martial law. He was awarded the Hilal-e-Imtiaz posthumously. He is the father of journalist Hamid Mir (Geo TV, Capital Talk). The school is named in honour of Prof. Waris Mir's legacy.
